citations.claim: first violation cart beyond track limit 2.4
just before violation, cart 0.05m from end moving left
earlier drift velocity -1.09 shows unchecked leftward drift

counterfactual.change: Changed initial.x from -0.24023586700581978 to 0.0, keeping all other fields identical. This removes the initial bias and keeps cart within track for 223 steps, showing controller can balance if not starting near edge.

explanation: Controller uses very small forces (<1N vs 44N limit) to keep pole near upright (theta ~ -0.08 rad, margin ~0.71) but allows cart position to drift left monotonic: x -0.24 -> -1.91 at step 200 (v -1.09) -> -2.347 at step 220 -> -2.419 at step 223. No pushes/noise. Feedback gains for this plant (cart_mass 0.65kg, pole_length 0.87m) do not sufficiently penalize cart position, so cart exits track while pole remains upright.

violation.detail: cart at x=-2.419 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart drifts progressively leftward across frames 220-223 while the pole remains nearly upright and stable. At step 223 the cart reaches the edge of the track and leaves the allowed region, triggering the cart_in_track violation.
